I'm Anburam, a freelance digital marketer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. I started Anburam.Digital with one mission — help local Tamil Nadu businesses compete online and grow beyond what they thought was possible.

I work directly with business owners — no middlemen, no junior executives handling your account. Every strategy, every campaign, every automation workflow is built by me personally.

My edge? I combine traditional marketing strategy with cutting-edge AI automation tools — so you get agency-quality work at freelancer-speed and price.

FAQ
COMMON QUESTIONS
We primarily work with local Tamil Nadu businesses — gyms, salons, restaurants, clinics, interior designers, retail shops, educational institutes, and service businesses. If you have a local customer base and want to grow it online, we're the right fit.
Our packages are designed for small and medium businesses. Pricing depends on the services you need — starting from ₹8,000/month for basic social media management to full-stack retainers. Book a free audit call and we'll give you a custom quote based on your goals.
For paid ads and lead generation, you can see results within the first 2 weeks. SEO and organic growth typically take 60–90 days to show significant movement. We set clear expectations upfront and share weekly reports so you always know where things stand.
AI Automation means we build smart workflows that handle repetitive tasks automatically — like sending follow-up messages to leads, updating your CRM, confirming appointments via WhatsApp, and alerting you when a new lead arrives. This saves you 10+ hours a week and ensures no lead falls through the cracks.
No lock-in contracts. We work on monthly retainers and believe in earning your business every month with results. Most clients stay long-term because they see value — not because they're forced to.
Yes! We create content in both Tamil and English depending on your target audience. For local businesses reaching everyday Tamil Nadu customers, Tamil-language content often performs significantly better — and we handle that natively.
